business_summary: Shenzhen Batian Ecotypic Engineering Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production, and operation of compound fertilizers and others in the People's Republic of China. It offers new fertilizers, slow-release fertilizers, stable compound fertilizers, microbial agents, microbial compound fertilizers, organic fertilizers, organic-inorganic compound fertilizers, soil conditioners, liquid fertilizers, water-soluble fertilizers, medium and trace element fertilizers, and other types of fertilizers. The company is also involved in the research and development, production, and operation of various chemical raw materials, new materials, building materials, etc.; development and utilization of phosphate resources; production and sale of mineral products; domestic trade; operation of import and export business; road freight transportation; and research and development, production, and sale of agricultural water supply equipment, such as sprinkler irrigation, micro-irrigation, and drip irrigation, as well as fertilization equipment, and automated irrigation control equipment. In addition, it engages in contracting the design and installation of farmland water conservancy, electromechanical equipment, and water-saving agricultural projects; operation of intellectual property rights in the fertilizer and chemical fields; and research and development, manufacturing, and sale of special electronic materials. The company was founded in 1989 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
business_summary_ko: Shenzhen Batian Ecotypic Engineering Co., Ltd.는 중화인민공화국에서 복합비료 등의 연구 개발, 생산, 운영에 종사하고 있습니다. 신규비료, 서방성비료, 안정복합비료, 미생물제, 미생물복합비료, 유기비료, 유무기복합비료, 토양개량제, 액체비료, 수용성비료, 중·미량원소비료, 기타 비료를 제공합니다. 이 회사는 또한 다양한 화학 원료, 신소재, 건축 자재 등의 연구 개발, 생산 및 운영에 참여하고 있습니다. 인산염 자원의 개발 및 활용; 광물 제품의 생산 및 판매; 국내 무역; 수출입 사업 운영; 도로 화물 운송; 스프링클러 관개, 미세 관개, 점적 관개 등 농업용수 공급 장비와 시비 장비, 자동 관개 제어 장비의 연구 개발, 생산 및 판매를 담당합니다. 또한 농경지 수자원 보호, 전기 설비의 설계 및 설치 계약을 체결합니다.
